# Forever

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Loops](Language-Features-Loops)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Repeat
statements
Forever
```

## Description

Ends a [Repeat](Repeat) loop that never stops by itself. Leave it with [Exit](Exit), [Goto](Goto), [Return](Return) or [End](End).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
n = 0
Repeat
	n = n + 1
	If n = 4 Then Exit
Forever
Print n
```

```text
4
```

## Related Commands

[Exit](Exit), [For](For), [Next](Next), [Repeat](Repeat)
